description: Detects writing style violations and AI tropes

hooks.command: IFS= read -r in; case $in in *--body*|*--message*|*--description*|*--title*|*=@*|*-F*|*--file*) if printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qE -- '--(body|message|description|title)[-= ]|(-F|--field)[= ][^ ]*=@|git (commit|tag).* (-F|--file)[= ]'; then printf '%s' "$in" | bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pretooluse.ts"; fi ;; esac
IFS= read -r in; if printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qE '([A-Za-z]+ ){4}' && printf '%s' "$in" | grep -qE '[A-Za-z][.!?]'; then printf '%s' "$in" | bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pretooluse.ts"; fi
